WHO WE ARE

Hargrove Firm is a local practice with a national footprint that focuses on high-net-worth estate planning. With attorney relationships across the country, it has some of the most innovative and sophisticated estate planning methods available. The Hargrove Firm strives to achieve its clients’ planning goals while maximizing tax savings for estate taxes and other taxes. The Hargrove Firm is partnering with online estate planning platform NetLaw to provide online Estate planning services for Hargrove Firm clients. Our Firm is expanding, and we are seeking highly qualified individuals ready to hit the ground running.

WHO YOU ARE

***Attorneys MUST BE ACTIVELY LICENSED & IN GOOD STANDING IN WYOMING***

If you’re a highly organized, hardworking, and self-motivated professional with extensive Estate Planning, Wills, and Trusts experience looking to grow your career with a creative and growing national enterprise, then we have an exciting opportunity for you! We are looking for ad-hoc Of Counsel Attorneys to create and review tailored estate planning documents and answer client questions using our proprietary platform. The ideal candidate is looking for additional work or to expand their practice, has a great attitude, and is eager to be a part provide excellent customer service.

Job Responsibilities:

Virtually consult with clients to review their estate plan; provide legal advice and guidance.
Review documents to ensure sure they are up to date on state requirements.
Ensure client goals have been met.
Ability to exercise good judgement when discussing estate plans with clients.

Skills and Qualifications

Excellent verbal and written communication skills
Computer skills: Zoom/Webex/Google meet, Microsoft & Google Suite
Experience as an attorney.
Basic Understanding of Estate Planning

Education & Experience requirements

· J.D. Degree required.

· Bar Admitted and in good standing.

· 3+ years expereince with Estate Planning, Wills, and Trusts

· Excellent communications skills.

· Attention to detail, solid organizational skills, and ability to prioritize tasks.

· Demonstrated experience with relevant firm software programs such as Microsoft Office Applications (Word, Outlook and Excel) and the firm’s case management system.

· Ability to anticipate the client’s needs and the firm’s needs to avoid surprises and unpreparedness for anyone.

Payment & Benefits

· Of Counsel attorneys are paid a fee of $200.00 per engagement

· Opportunities to receive referral bonuses available

· Free Access to Estate Planning Platform

· This position is not eligible for benefits or overtime
